title: goodpatch-sculpture
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of Goodpatch, https://goodpatch.com/ja. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 青い立体オブジェクトの素材感と大胆なスケール。記憶に残る象徴物を中心に置く。
Direction: Use the Goodpatch screenshot's tactile sculptural COBALT 3D approach, adapted into a predominantly WHITE hero. A huge beautifully rendered cobalt communications headset with a correctly modeled boom microphone floats as the primary sculpture in the CENTER-RIGHT, with a few soft 3D speech-bubble forms and subtle reflections. Two very small friendly stylized operators at a white desk underneath convey call-center work. Bold navy Japanese type LEFT, generous white negative space, museum-quality product/brand sculpture aesthetics, no heart/star copies from the source, no full dark background or generic anime meeting.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "声の仕事に、" / "新しいかたちを。"; subcopy "人と人をつなぐ、コールセンター。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.

attached_images.role: actual website screenshot; sculptural visual material and scale reference

borrowed_visual_element: 青い立体オブジェクトの素材感と大胆なスケール。記憶に残る象徴物を中心に置く。

visual_inspection.headline: Exact and readable: 声の仕事に、 / 新しいかたちを。
visual_inspection.subcopy: Exact and readable: 人と人をつなぐ、コールセンター。
visual_inspection.reference_composition: Oversized tactile cobalt headset sculpture and soft volumetric speech forms adapt the real Goodpatch screenshot's blue sculptural vocabulary on a white hero.
visual_inspection.call_center: Two small operators wearing headsets with microphones, screens and desk telephone.
visual_inspection.source_identity: No copied source logos, slogans, heart/star figures, identities, client names or statistics.
